title: Devices
newSubtitle: Connect a spare phone, laptop or IP camera
demoNotice: Example data. Connecting, saving and removing cameras require a configured server and a signed-in family account.

empty.title: Your first camera starts here
empty.body: Use a spare phone or laptop to watch over a room. Add a camera to create its connection code.

offline.title: A camera is disconnected
offline.body: No connection signal has arrived for at least 90 seconds. This camera cannot send new alerts while disconnected.
offline.help: Check its power and internet. Keep the camera page open and the screen awake. It reconnects when connection signals resume.

wake.hint: A notification goes to the camera phone. When someone at home taps it, the camera starts again.
wake.sent: Notification sent to the camera phone
wake.unavailable: This camera can't receive notifications yet, or one was just sent. Use Reconnect with QR below.
wake.failed: Couldn't send the notification. Try again.

reconnect.hint: Scan the QR with the camera phone. This camera comes back with its room, settings and history and starts watching.
reconnect.scan: On the camera phone, open the camera app and scan this QR, or enter the code on the camera page.
reconnect.failed: Couldn't create a QR. Try again.
reconnect.qrAlt: QR code to reconnect the camera

pairing.cctv: IP cameras connect through the Halo server: it pairs the camera with this code (see cctv/README.md).
pairing.scanBody: Scan this QR code on the camera's phone or laptop, or open Camera mode there and enter the six-digit code.
pairing.qrAlt: QR code to connect this camera
pairing.waiting: Waiting for the camera to connect…
pairing.copyFailed: Could not copy. Scan the QR code or enter the code instead.
pairing.expiredBody: Create another code to connect the camera. Each code works once for ten minutes.
pairing.successBody: {name} has joined your family. On the camera device, allow camera and microphone access and start watching.
pairing.step1: Give the camera a name and choose its room.
pairing.step2: Open the connection link on the device that will become the camera.
pairing.step3: Allow camera and microphone access. Keep it plugged in, with the screen awake.

details.syncHint: Changes reach a connected camera with its next connection signal, usually within 30 seconds.
details.saved: Changes saved. The camera will receive them on its next connection signal.

fall.label: Falls
fall.hint: Sudden descent followed by staying down

hazard.label: Hazard sounds
hazard.hint: Breaking glass and smoke or fire alarms

delete.title: Remove camera
delete.explanation: Removing it stops its access to your family. Earlier events remain in your history.
delete.confirmBody: {name} will stop sending alerts to your family. To reconnect it later, you will need a new connection code.

errors.invalid: Check the name, room and detection settings. Names must contain 1–60 characters.
errors.unavailable: The server is not configured. This example cannot save changes or connect cameras.
errors.unauthorized: Sign in to your family account to continue.
errors.notFound: This camera or connection code is no longer available to your family.
errors.failed: Could not complete this request. Check your connection and try again.
errors.limit: Your family already has five active codes. Use one or wait for it to expire.
errors.conflict: Another caregiver changed this camera. Review the latest settings before saving. This will discard your unsaved draft.

loadError.title: Could not load cameras
loadError.body: Check your connection and try again. Your camera settings have not been changed.
